verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a memory and context API that sits in the tool-provider role. It is not an agent or assistant that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error. The evidence only shows Supermemory serving MCP (its own MCP memory server and a docs MCP for coding agents), which is server-side and does not count toward this client-side story.
